mcp_tools.name: meeting_decisions_and_actions_extract
mcp_tools.title: Meeting decisions and actions extract
mcp_tools.description: Submits a meeting decisions-and-actions extraction record (source and meeting identity, decisions fidelity, action ownership and dates, open questions and carry-forward, recap draft and handoff, red lines) and returns a deterministic MEETING_EXTRACTION_SOUND / MEETING_EXTRACTION_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed per-decision anchor and per-action owner/date coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it extracts nothing from any transcript.

inputSchema.description: The meeting decisions and actions extract manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

decisions.description: Declared decisions: {name, source_anchor, faithful_to_source, is_inferred, inference_marked}.

expect.notes: All fields present and valid. Computed spot checks: decisions_count=1, actions_count=1, open_questions_count=1.
